question: In a certain code language, 'MUTUAL' is written as '12121202113', 'MARKET' is written as '2051118113', how will 'MODULE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'MUTUAL' is written as '12121202113'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff7685a4a420bded8ea2b1393943fe50d4c503b5731a345c0526a2ff75d07bea.png] 

And,

'MARKET' is written as '2051118113'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4907fd2f714c6f4e551a220663ddfcdf0156eb6e35aafa58ea0b891965a380dc.png] 

Similarly,

'MODULE' is written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af41acc42c7cc355ed66f79f81f7614b3ef32cd655f9458f29b122f7f65a8283.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
